Package com.miniandmore.app.service.criteria

Class ProductCriteria

java.lang.Object
com.miniandmore.app.service.criteria.ProductCriteria
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable, tech.jhipster.service.Criteria
public class ProductCriteria extends Object implements Serializable, tech.jhipster.service.Criteria
Criteria class for the Product entity. This class is used in
invalid reference 
com.miniandmore.app.web.rest.ProductResource
to receive all the possible filtering options from the Http GET request parameters. For example the following could be a valid request: /products?id.greaterThan=5&attr1.contains=something&attr2.specified=false As Spring is unable to properly convert the types, unless specific Filter class are used, we need to use fix type specific filters.
